title: Rabbi Sidor
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Challah 2:1: “Rabbi Sidor taught [a baraita] supporting Rabbi Mana.” In Shabbat, chapter 7, beginning of halakhah 2: “Rabbi Sidor said: Yehudah beRabbi studied Makhshirin for six months; in the end a student of Rabbi Simai came, and he could not answer him,” etc.

notes.text: The supplied form יהודה ברבי is retained as Yehudah beRabbi; it is not automatically expanded into a claim that his father was “Rabbi.” The Guggenheimer digital Shabbat 7:2 has the six-month study and unanswered question; it does not explicitly give a father’s personal name here.
